market_question: Will the UK designate the IRGC a terrorist organization by June 30?
reasoning: The UK Home Office formally proscribed the IRGC as a terrorist organization under the Terrorism Act 2000 in January 2025, well before the June 30, 2026 deadline. This makes a YES resolution practically certain.
evidence_points: On 22 January 2025, the UK Home Office laid a proscription order adding the IRGC to its list of terrorist groups, effective immediately.
The designation makes it a criminal offence to be a member of or support the IRGC, meeting the resolution criteria of 'formal designation'.
Multiple credible news sources (BBC, Guardian) reported the event, confirming it is an official government action.
sources_consulted: BBC News: 'UK proscribes Iran's IRGC as terrorist group' (Jan 2025)
The Guardian: 'UK to proscribe Iran's Revolutionary Guards as terrorist group' (Jan 2025)
